newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cuts boost unemployed Australia numbers - Oppn.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cuts boost unemployed Australia numbers - Oppn.

text.p: Australian Opposition Leader Kim Beazley said on Tuesday the government's cuts to labour market programmes would add 5,000 to 10,000 people a month to unemployment levels, a party spokesman told reporters.

"The collapse of the Working Nation programme, or rather the abolition of the Working Nation programme means that five to ten thousand unemployed persons will join the ranks of the unemployed each month," the party spokesman quoted Beazley as telling a regular meeting of Labor members of parliament.
Australia had 807,100 unemployed people in August, 8.8 percent of its 9.2 million labour force.
Trend figures show the number of unemployed people has been tending to rise by 2,000 to 3,000 a month recently.
